purpose: A hand-scale, original genus-level fossil left valve of Exogyra informed by named E. ponderosa specimens. One deep asymmetric cup with a short lateral coiled umbo, continuous thick rim and real interior adductor-scar relief. Not a scan, specimen replica or live-animal reconstruction.

criteria.description: Validate shipped static GLB, official format validation, scale/origin, exact geometry/texture budgets and provenance.

Deep irregular cup, eccentric short sideward coil, continuous thick rim and quiet concave interior must read in neutral clay. No centered horn, detached disk, gastropod whorls, uniform scallop symmetry, rocky clutter or floating growth bands.
Genus-level fossil valve, informed by the named E. ponderosa specimen views. Do not claim scan identity, exact fossil measurements, live color or soft anatomy.
Verify the frozen brief, complete deliverables and all explicit constraints.
Parse this exact GLB with the pinned target loader and record bounds, materials and errors.
Render this exact GLB in the target graphics runtime; inspect frames and capture renderer/device and measured work.
Render the intended composed scene including this exact GLB; inspect scale/contact/material consistency and measure scene work.

view_exemptions.detail: Full top/interior view supplies internal scar context; optional close-up can be requested by independent QA.

coverage_justification: Targeted R1/R2 form repair: all eleven original named views, four elevated cardinal views, and supplemental reverse neutral-clay lighting cover the changed apex, shoulders, outer growth arcs and preserved cavity. This does not reuse old images as proof of new geometry; the prior full-orbit evidence remains with immutable r007.

subject.era_context: Late Cretaceous, no exact locality assigned
subject.scale_uncertainty: Artistic hand-scale envelope, not a measured specimen
subject.axis: Z up, -Y presentation front; aperture tilted 24 degrees toward -Y; umbo posterior-left
subject.budget_rationale: Single close-inspection prop. Rings preserve modest growth relief and a readable thick cavity; coil gets extra sampling; no texture memory.

maker_revision_intent: R1: continuous broad umbonal shoulder supporting a short rounded lateral curl, no flat basal cap or handle hole. R2: unequal margin/shoulder development and sparse irregular growth arcs from a shared eccentric apex; preserve quiet deep cavity.
